A few hours later and the view across the Wadden Sea has transformed into a maze of deep channels, drying sandbanks, salt marshes and mud flats. As the largest unbroken system of intertidal sand and mud flats in the world , this ever-changing habitat stretches hundreds of miles along the north European coasts of Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands and was awarded world heritage status…

items.summary: Thanks to Jilly Cooper, tartan and tweed, waxed jackets and wellies are a style vibe right now British heritage, in fashion terms, is a country where it is permanently October. A conker-brown and pleasant land, if you will. Brand Britain in the style sense comes into its own in autumn: roaring fires, muddy lanes, damp dogs. Waxed jackets and chunky knits, tartan and tweed, jaunty scarves to banish draughts. Clothes for going on a hearty walk, but with a hip flask in your pocket. Fashion has been mining this seam since long before Brideshead Revisited made battered evening dresses and Oxford bags look romantic, and it keeps returning, because trad British style is satisfyingly utilitarian…
